summary.name: Microsoft Copilot
summary.one_liner: Microsoft Copilot is a web-based AI chat assistant (accessed via bing.com/chat) for answering questions, drafting content, generating images, and searching the web.
use_cases: Searching the web for sourced answers
Getting help understanding concepts and assignments
summary.what_it_does: Microsoft Copilot is a chat-based AI assistant that answers questions, brainstorms ideas, and helps think through projects in a single conversation. It searches the web and returns answers it describes as grounded, meaning tied to sources. It can draft content and generate images from text descriptions. The page also presents it as a learning aid for explaining concepts and working through assignments, and offers a desktop app download.
notable: Web search combined with chat for sourced answers
Listed as Bing Chat in the source listing, marked free
caveats: Page does not state pricing tiers; the free label comes only from the external listing
Sign-in is required per the page heading
